targetText: It is the cost required for the maintenance of the labourer as a labourer, and for his education and training as a labourer.
explanation: The cost of production of labor-power includes the essential food, housing, healthcare, and education needed for a worker to perform their job daily.

targetText: Thus, the cost of production of simple labour-power amounts to the cost of the existence and propagation of the worker.
explanation: The baseline minimum wage equals the economic cost required for working people to survive and raise the next generation of workers.
